statements.status_notes: certifi 2026.1.4 is the copy vendored in the pip 26.0.1 wheel that virtualenv 21.15.5 bundles only for Python 3.9. This image runs Python 3.13, and virtualenv selects pip 26.3 for that interpreter. pip 26.3 vendors certifi 2026.10.23, and the application copy is pinned to 2026.10.23. Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2
